SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.tags, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.user_id, a.create_time, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.name AS category_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id
AND a.category_id = #{categoryId} AND FIND_IN_SET(#{tag}, a.tags)
AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.tags, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.user_id, a.create_time, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.name AS category_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id ORDER BY a.like_count DESC, a.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.tags, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.user_id, a.create_time, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.name AS category_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.id != #{id} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.tags, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.user_id, a.create_time, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.name AS category_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.tags, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.user_id, a.create_time, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.name AS category_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.tags, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.user_id, a.create_time, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.name AS category_name, 1 AS is_favorited FROM article a INNER JOIN collect col ON a.id = col.article_id LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE col.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY col.create_time DESC
